verdict.rationale: OpenHands supports resuming conversations and switching between local/remote/cloud agents 'without losing focus,' implying some cross-surface continuity, but there's no explicit documentation of a developer taking over a live in-progress task from editor/terminal/browser mid-run with redirect capability. missing for 10: explicit IDE/editor integration for live takeover, concrete UI/UX description of mid-task redirect, and independent hands-on confirmation of seamless handoff across all three surfaces.
